title: Release Automation MCP Tools Schema
description: Comprehensive JSON schema definitions for all MCP server tools in the release automation system

tools.name: jira_get_release_tickets
tools.description: Fetches all JIRA tickets tagged for a specific release version with PR information, approval status, and merge status. Returns ticket metadata required for merge phase validation.

include_pr_details.description: Whether to fetch detailed PR information including approvals and conflicts

tickets.description: List of tickets associated with this release

approved.description: Whether PR meets approval threshold (approval_count >= required_approvals)

error_codes.description: Failed to connect to JIRA API
No tickets found for specified release version
Release version does not match expected pattern
Invalid JIRA API credentials

tools.name: git_check_pr_approvals
tools.description: Checks if a pull request has the minimum required approvals (default: 2) before merge. Returns approval status, current approvers, PR owner, and list of potential reviewers if approvals are insufficient.

pr_id.description: Pull request ID or number (e.g., '123' or 'PR-456')

required_approvals.description: Override required approval count (default: 2 from constitution)

approvers.description: List of users who approved the PR

potential_reviewers.description: Suggested reviewers if approvals insufficient (empty if approved)

pr_url.description: Full URL to the pull request

error_codes.description: Pull request does not exist
Failed to connect to Git platform API
Invalid Git platform API credentials
Insufficient permissions to access PR details

tools.name: git_merge_tickets_to_development
tools.description: Merges ticket feature branches to development branch following GitFlow with squash merge strategy for clean commit history. Each squash commit uses format '[TICKET-ID] Summary'. Attempts auto-resolution of conflicts if enabled, returns list of merged tickets and any conflicts requiring manual intervention.

ticket_ids.description: List of JIRA ticket IDs to merge (e.g., ['PROJ-123', 'PROJ-124'])

merge_strategy.description: Merge strategy: 'squash' for feature→development (clean history), 'merge' for development→release (full history)

squash_commit_messages.description: Map of ticket_id to squash commit message (format: '[TICKET-ID] Summary'). Required when merge_strategy is 'squash'.

auto_resolve_conflicts.description: Attempt automatic conflict resolution with 95% confidence threshold

conflicts.description: Tickets with unresolved conflicts requiring manual intervention

files.description: List of file paths with conflicts

confidence_score.description: AI confidence score (0-100) if auto-resolution attempted

total_requested.description: Total number of tickets requested to merge

error_codes.description: Feature branch for ticket does not exist
Target branch (development) does not exist
PR does not meet minimum approval requirement (2 approvals)
Merge conflicts exist and auto-resolution confidence < 95%
Failed to connect to Git platform API
Squash commit message does not match required format '[TICKET-ID] Summary'

tools.name: git_create_release_branch
tools.description: Creates a release branch from development branch following GitFlow naming convention (release/vX.Y.Z). Preserves full commit history from development (no squash). Returns branch name and commit SHA.

source_branch.description: Source branch to create release from (default: 'development')

release_type.description: Type of release: regular uses 'release/' prefix, hotfix uses 'hotfix/' prefix

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA at branch creation point

created.description: Whether branch was newly created (false if already existed)

ticket_count.description: Number of commits included in this release branch

error_codes.description: Source branch does not exist
Version does not match semantic versioning pattern
Release branch with this version already exists (returns existing branch details)
Failed to connect to Git platform API
Insufficient permissions to create branch

tools.name: jenkins_trigger_deployment
tools.description: Triggers Jenkins deployment job for a specific tenant and release version. Returns job queue ID and initial status. Supports parallel tenant deployments with independent failure handling.

jenkins_job_parameters.description: Additional Jenkins job parameters (e.g., build configuration)

release_type.description: Type of release: regular (cannot deploy to PROD) or hotfix (can deploy to PROD)

triggered_at.description: Timestamp when job was triggered (ISO 8601 UTC)

error_codes.description: Tenant configuration does not exist for specified environment
Regular releases cannot deploy to PROD environment (use hotfix branch)
Failed to connect to Jenkins API
Jenkins job for tenant does not exist
Invalid Jenkins API credentials
Jenkins queue is full, retry after delay

tools.name: jenkins_get_job_status
tools.description: Retrieves current status of one or more Jenkins deployment jobs. Returns execution status, duration, error messages, and cache clearing status as reported by Jenkins job execution. Used for polling deployment progress.

deployment_ids.description: List of deployment IDs to check status for

include_console_output.description: Whether to include last 50 lines of console output for debugging

jenkins_build_number.description: Jenkins build number (null if still queued)

started_at.description: Job start timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC, null if queued)

completed_at.description: Job completion timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC, null if not completed)

duration_ms.description: Deployment duration in milliseconds (null if not completed)

error_message.description: Error description if status is failed or error

console_output_tail.description: Last 50 lines of console output (if requested)

cache_clear_status.description: Cache clearing status as reported by Jenkins job

error_codes.description: One or more deployment IDs do not exist
Failed to connect to Jenkins API
Invalid Jenkins API credentials

tools.name: jenkins_rollback_tenant
tools.description: Triggers rollback deployment for a specific tenant to previous release version. Supports per-tenant rollback without affecting other tenants. Must complete within 15 minutes of original deployment per constitution.

previous_version.description: Previous release version to rollback to (e.g., 'v1.1.0')

rollback_reason.description: Reason for rollback (e.g., 'critical production error', 'failed health checks')

jenkins_queue_id.description: Jenkins queue item ID for rollback job

jenkins_job_url.description: URL to Jenkins rollback job console

triggered_at.description: Timestamp when rollback was triggered (ISO 8601 UTC)

error_codes.description: Tenant configuration does not exist
Tenant does not support automated rollback
Previous version does not exist or was never deployed
Failed to connect to Jenkins API
Rollback must be triggered within 30 minutes of deployment

tools.name: jira_update_ticket_status
tools.description: Updates JIRA ticket status after successful or partial deployment. Supports batch updates for multiple tickets. Retries with exponential backoff on transient failures without blocking deployment workflow.

ticket_ids.description: List of JIRA ticket IDs to update (e.g., ['PROJ-123', 'PROJ-124'])

deployment_details.description: Additional deployment context to add as comment

failed_tenants.description: List of tenants that failed deployment

add_comment.description: Whether to add deployment details as JIRA comment

total_requested.description: Total number of tickets requested to update

total_failed.description: Number of tickets that failed to update

error_codes.description: Failed to connect to JIRA API (retried with exponential backoff)
One or more tickets do not exist
Status transition not allowed by JIRA workflow
Invalid JIRA API credentials
Insufficient permissions to update ticket status

tools.name: teams_notify_pr_owner
tools.description: Sends personalized Microsoft Teams notification to PR owner when approvals are insufficient or merge conflicts are detected. Includes actionable context like current approval count, potential reviewers, or conflict file locations.

pr_owner_email.description: PR owner's email address for Teams notification

conflicted_files.description: List of file paths with conflicts

confidence_score.description: AI confidence score if auto-resolution was attempted

teams_message_id.description: Teams API message ID after delivery

error_codes.description: Failed to connect to Microsoft Teams API
PR owner email not found in Teams directory
Invalid Teams API credentials
Message content exceeds Teams message size limit
Teams API rate limit exceeded, retry after delay

tools.name: teams_announce_deployment
tools.description: Sends deployment completion announcement to Teams main channel including release version, ticket count, target environment, per-tenant deployment status (success/failed), per-tenant cache clearing status (cleared/skipped/failed), and completion time. AI generates context-aware summary.

ticket_ids.description: List of JIRA tickets included in this release

cache_clear_status.description: Cache clearing status as reported by Jenkins

error_message.description: Error description if status is failed

deployment_summary.description: AI-generated summary of deployment (e.g., 'All 10 tenants deployed successfully in 12 minutes')

severity.description: Announcement severity based on deployment outcome

channel_id.description: Teams channel ID to post announcement (default: main release channel)
Teams channel ID where announcement was posted

teams_message_id.description: Teams API message ID after delivery

error_codes.description: Failed to connect to Microsoft Teams API
Specified Teams channel does not exist
Invalid Teams API credentials
Message content exceeds Teams message size limit
Teams API rate limit exceeded, retry after delay

tools.name: trigger_release_deployment
tools.description: Main orchestration tool that triggers the complete release deployment workflow. This is the primary entry point for AI agents to initiate a release. Orchestrates all phases: merge, branch creation, deployment, and post-deployment. Returns release ID for status tracking.

release_type.description: Type of release: regular (cannot deploy to PROD) or hotfix (can deploy to PROD)

tenant_ids.description: Target tenant IDs for deployment (default: all tenants for environment)

auto_resolve_conflicts.description: Whether to attempt automatic conflict resolution with 95% confidence threshold

pause_on_blockers.description: Whether to pause workflow when approvals insufficient or conflicts detected (vs. failing immediately)

triggered_by.description: User or system identifier that triggered the release

ticket_count.description: Number of tickets included in this release

tenant_count.description: Number of tenants targeted for deployment

created_by.description: User or system that triggered release

error_codes.description: No tickets found in JIRA for specified release version
Regular releases cannot deploy to PROD environment (use hotfix branch)
One or more tenants not configured for target environment
Failed to start n8n workflow execution
Release type must be 'regular' or 'hotfix'
Another release with same version is already in progress
